personalInfo.name: Arwa Elsayed Eldesawy
personalInfo.title: AI Engineer
personalInfo.bio: Entry-level AI Engineer with a strong foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and Generative AI. Experienced in developing AI applications and intelligent workflows using Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, FastAPI, LLM APIs, and n8n, with internship experience in ML/DL model development and RAG. Strong foundation in AI integration, REST API development, and workflow automation.
